Markets in Amsterdam this week

All this week's events

23 – 29 Nov · 12 events

Flea markets, craft and design fairs, food markets and record or book sales that last a day or a weekend. Ideal for bargain hunters, collectors and anyone who likes to browse and meet the makers. The list is refreshed every week, so you can plan your weekend around it. Every listing is checked on the organiser's own page. Times and prices can change, so check the organiser's link before you go.

Showing today onwards

  1. Winter Market Leidseplein

    Christmas Markets · Markets · Food · Drink

    When
    Daily, Mon 23 – Sun 29 Nov (runs until 3 Jan), Mon–Fri 12:00–23:00; Sat & Sun 11:00–23:00
    Where
    Leidseplein & Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen, Amsterdam (Leidseplein, Centrum)
    Price
    Free entry; pay per stall
    Organiser

    Wooden chalets on Leidseplein and the Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen selling Christmas decorations, gifts, cheese, oliebollen and hot snacks, with a mulled-wine tower and a big Christmas tree. Runs until 3 January.
